entries.label: Guardian/Gort · NECA Ultimate2021
entries.sourceEdition: NECA Ultimate Guardian/Gort Lost Tribe, item51423, publisher article June2020, release May2021; licensed Predator2character toy edition
entries.prompt:
Generate ONE isolated rigid biomask from the actual NECA Ultimate Guardian/Gort Lost Tribe toy edition released May 2021 (item51423). The FIRST reference is the official white-background catalogue: isolate ONLY the silver metallic mask worn by the standing MAIN FIGURE at image left, keeping that source near-frontal camera, slight tilt and proportions. The SECOND official staged photograph corroborates the same sculpture and seams, but its blue/orange scene lighting is not the base paint and must not be copied as a colourway. Do not substitute PHG Gort, Boar, Snake, Warrior/Ram, Scout, or any other mask. Do not use the separate bare head/accessories at right in the catalogue.

Keep the full metallic silver-grey rigid shell: tall flared crown with clipped/notched upper central rim, broad segmented upper side plates/rounded rib panels, real small central raised fasteners/plates, the strongly arched swept silver brow over two dark elongated eye lenses, the narrow bridge, sculpted curled cheek housings with round recessed ports, and the central dark rounded mouth respirator with its visible vertical rigid grille ribs and lower tooth-like metal bars. Preserve the actually visible angular contour, seam arrangement and worn silver/grey paint; do not add biological teeth, mandibular tusks, horns, new vents, or extra glyphs/runes. Treat dark lenses and real black grill recesses as solid dark material; the respirator is not a hole to expose a mouth.

Remove every wearer component: all black dreadlocks and bands, skin and living cranium, neck, collar, all body/chest/shoulder armor, shoulder cannon, weapons, hands, stand, separate unmasked head, skulls, scene and catalogue background. Keep only the rigid metal biomask, not a severed head. No reconstruction of unseen back/interior or a new profile, no frontalization or symmetry redesign. A should follow the neutral diffuse catalogue lighting and restrained patinated metallic paint; no dramatic cyan/orange light, no chrome mirror, no invented decorative microtexture.

One complete mask only, on genuine transparent alpha, no floor, support or shadow plane, no labels/text/grid. Request1254x1254square if supported. The complete object should occupy78–80percent of the largest canvas axis with8–12percent clear margin on every side, including crown and lower grille, no clipped edge, no digital stretching. This is an edition study from licensed toy photographs, not certification of an original film prop.

notes: Source near-front camera and complete silver shell retained, no wearer/dreadlocks/armor.
Forehead side plates, dark lenses and central rigid grille retained; scene blue/orange colours not treated as paint.

limitations: Primary catalogue1040x1300 shows the full near-front rigid mask at modest mask-area resolution; second official867x1300 scene corroborates larger sculpture under coloured light.
Micro engravings/fastener shapes cannot be certified pixel-exact from toy catalogue photos; no hidden back or film geometry claimed.
Publisher article2020 and announced releaseMay2021 are distinguished; this is the photographed licensed toy edition.
Native visible minimum margin is below requested8–12percent; no edge clipping observed and no crop/resize/raster change performed.

entries.prompt:
Create ONE PHG-quality PBR presentation of the exact isolated Guardian/Gort Ultimate2021 silver mask in reference1, using references2and3 only to check its real photographed edition. Reference1 is the accepted isolated A; it controls the entire silhouette, camera, scale proportions, crown outline, face panels, lens shapes, grille, palette and worn paint. Keep that SAME near-front source camera and every actual feature. This is a rendering standardization, not a new mask or redesign.

Preserve the broad tall crown, central notched/raised upper tab and axial panel divisions, rounded stepped side plates, three actual central fasteners, thick arched brow, two solid dark elongated eye lenses, curled cheek channels and circular ports, dark respirator cavity with its existing vertical bars and lower square tooth-like metal bars. Preserve precisely the number and position of the prominent ribs/panels/fasteners/ports you can see in A; do not add or merge holes, engravings, letters, glowing emitters, horns or living teeth. Maintain the restrained silver-grey patinated paint and dark irregular wear distribution, not gold/chrome or blue/orange albedo. No wearer biology, dreadlocks, body, helmet collar, cannon, hoses, text, support or scene. Do not invent hidden rear/interior shape or another camera, do not symmetrize.

Change only rendering to the coherent quality of modern Predator Hunting Grounds inventory biomasks: neutral soft key from upper image-left, gentle front fill, controlled material roughness with restrained diffuse grain, readable sculpted edge relief and recesses. Keep weathering and sculptured roughness rather than polishing it to mirror chrome or adding noisy rock cracks. It is already a PBR-looking source, so a subtle honest restage is appropriate; do not manufacture differences by redesigning its geometry or paint. One mask, genuine alpha background, no floor or cast-shadow plane. Request1254x1254square if supported; occupy78–80percent of the largest canvas axis with8–12percent clear margin all sides, no clipping/crop or new view. The result remains a photographed NECA toy edition study, with no canonical film or human art validation claimed.

notes: Same crown/panels/fasteners/dark lenses/respirator bars and source near-front camera kept from A.
Neutral key/fill restaging, no added biology or invented canonical markings.
